resources.string: This device and another member\'s see different roles for this channel: the server may be showing people different lists. Chat isn\'t affected, and deleting this channel takes the retention on this device. Tell a workspace admin, who can check the roles here.

This device or a member\'s can\'t vouch for every role here, or the member list shows one nobody confirmed. You can check them if you want to: what you confirm counts on every member\'s device. Chat isn\'t affected.
You can check this channel\'s roles if you want to: what you confirm counts on every member\'s device.
New: only the server says this person has this role. Make sure it\'s right, and that the name is who you think it is.
This device knows no signed roles for this channel. Anybody who holds one elsewhere and isn\'t on this list would lose it, and can\'t be named here.
Key changed: this device saw another security key for this person than the signed roles name. That\'s normal after they set up their account again; if they didn\'t, ask them before you confirm.

This device can\'t check that the security key of somebody marked here is really theirs: only the server says so. A workspace admin who is in this channel can confirm these roles, once that person is in its encryption group.
Confirming takes a role from or lowers the role of: %1$s. Only the server\'s list says so, so make sure that\'s right.
The member list doesn\'t say who somebody here is, so these roles can\'t be confirmed. Try again once the list has loaded.
The channel\'s roles changed while you were looking, and nothing was confirmed. Check them again.
A channel needs an admin. Give somebody the admin role first.
